items.exampleEn: Please include only relevant information in your report.
items.exampleZh: 報告裡請只放相關的資訊。

items.exampleEn: I keep all my old photos on an external hard drive.
items.exampleZh: 我把所有舊照片都存在外接硬碟裡。

items.exampleEn: The guide gives a comprehensive list of hotels in the city.
items.exampleZh: 這本指南列出了市內飯店的完整清單。

items.exampleEn: Water is vital for all living things.
items.exampleZh: 水對所有生物都至關重要。

items.exampleEn: The new factory uses very sophisticated machines.
items.exampleZh: 這座新工廠使用非常精密的機器。

items.exampleEn: Thank you for your prompt reply.
She gave us a detailed plan for the trip.
items.exampleZh: 她給了我們一份詳細的旅行計畫。

items.exampleEn: The two companies have not reached a concrete agreement yet.
items.exampleZh: 兩家公司還沒有達成具體的協議。

items.sentenceEn: Please send me a detailed report of the costs by Friday.
items.sentenceZh: 請在星期五前寄給我一份詳細的費用報告。

items.audioEn: At tomorrow's meeting, we need concrete ideas, not general comments.
items.audioZh: 明天的會議上，我們需要具體的點子，而不是籠統的意見。

items.sentenceEn: Good communication is vital in a small team.
items.sentenceZh: 在小團隊裡，良好的溝通至關重要。

items.sentenceEn: This phone has a sophisticated camera that works well at night.
items.sentenceZh: 這支手機有一顆精密的相機，晚上也拍得很好。

items.stemEn: Her advice was very ____ to my situation, so I followed it right away.
items.stemZh: 她的建議和我的處境非常相關，所以我馬上照做了。

items.stemEn: The ____ walls of the house are white, but inside, every room is painted blue.
items.stemZh: 這棟房子的外牆是白色的，但裡面每個房間都漆成藍色。

items.passageEn: Last month, our company asked an external firm to review our computer system. The firm sent us a comprehensive report of forty pages. It was very detailed, and every point was relevant to our daily work. The report said our system was not sophisticated enough for a company of our size. It gave concrete examples, such as slow email and old security software. The experts said that fixing these problems was vital, and they asked for a prompt decision. Our manager agreed, and the existing system will be replaced by the end of the year.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我們公司請一家外部公司檢查我們的電腦系統。對方寄來一份四十頁的全面報告。報告非常詳細，每一點都和我們的日常工作相關。報告指出，以我們公司的規模來說，系統不夠先進。報告舉了具體例子，例如電子郵件很慢、防護軟體老舊。專家們說，解決這些問題至關重要，並請我們迅速做出決定。經理同意了，年底前現有的系統就會被換掉。

questions.questionZh: 外部公司的報告指出什麼問題？
options: 負責電腦的員工人數太少

questions.questionZh: 報告舉了哪些具體例子？
options: 印表機常壞、網路費用太貴
電子郵件很慢、防護軟體老舊

items.promptZh: 我們需要一份更詳細的計畫。
referenceEn: We need a more detailed plan.
We need a plan that is more detailed.
rubricZh: detailed 是形容詞，比較級是 more detailed（例如 a more detailed plan）

items.instructionZh: 用 vital 造一個句子，說說你覺得工作或生活中極為重要的一件事。
referenceEn: I think it is vital to keep a good balance between work and family.
For me, a good night's sleep is vital to doing my job well.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 vital，表示「極為重要的」（例如 is vital to／for…、It is vital to…）
句子要說到你自己的看法
